doc_edits.what: Amend AC-10.2's last sentence (text in ac_rows). doc_edits.section: §13 Accounts and providers — Store paragraph (line 649), schema block (612-632), Credential injection (655)
doc_edits.what: Replace the line-649 sentence with the single-grant rule: per pool at most one official slot; auth.json[pool] is that slot's grant; it has no accounts.secrets.json entry; K-π never calls oauth.refresh on it (the base runtime refreshes it on every request); non-official slots exist only in accounts.secrets.json and are refreshed by K-π; a pooled OAuth login the runtime persisted into auth.json becomes the official slot and the previous official slot keeps the grant auth.json held until then as a K-π-refreshed secret (loginAccount reads it live immediately before login); reconciliation runs once per session_start, by content match (refresh or access token equal, or api key equal), then the legacy rule (bind `default` only when its secret is absent or an expired OAuth copy), else a fresh official slot (`default`, else next `slot-N`); a flagged slot whose auth.json entry vanished is marked needsLogin `auth.json no longer holds a <pool> credential`. Document in the schema block: `official?: true` (at most one per pool, never on a local slot) and `needsLogin?: string` (persisted reason; balancer.selectInFamily never selects it; putSlot on re-login clears it). Under Credential injection add: for the official slot the runtime's own auth header is left in place and only request attribution is recorded; Anthropic OAuth requests identify as Claude Code (`user-agent: claude-cli/<v>`, upstream constant, cherry-picked pin 2.1.251); a claude_code_version_too_old refusal is a client-identity failure — notified once per session at level error, no cooldown, no failover, assistant diagnostic `kpi_client_version_rejected` with details { sent?, required?, slot? } which never triggers the agent-session retry (only kpi_account_failover does).

Add to Action/Pass evidence: rotate the auth.json grant out from under the official slot and start a session — no `could not refresh` warning, accounts.json shows `official: true` on the slot, accounts.secrets.json has no `anthropic/default`; break a non-official slot's refresh token — one notification `K-π accounts: anthropic/<slot> needs a new login: Anthropic rejected its refresh token (invalid_grant). Run /accounts login anthropic <slot>`, the widget shows `<slot> ?% needs login`, no stack trace; send a request with a below-floor Claude Code identity — one `K-π <version> identifies to Anthropic as Claude Code …` notification, the slot is not cooled. ACs: AC-10.1–10.10.

deviations: Product decision applied: the gate dialog's last line is `Revision N` (the human node's run count) with no `of <cap>` and no EXHAUSTED warning; the design's test 'the third change request ends EXHAUSTED naming the plan node cap' was not written, and the healthcheck/plan-approval tests assert the title does not match / of \d|EXHAUSTED/.

Last clause of the dismissed-gate/resume test: the design asked to stop the run after plan approval with 'a factory whose implement session throws once'. A node error puts the engine in status `failed`, whose checkpoint resumeLoop refuses ('Cannot resume graph in failed state'), so that shape cannot show a resume. Implemented instead with a harness whose hasUI getter turns false once the plan gate is answered: the release gate stops NEEDS_HUMAN (recovery approval, 'Approve gated release needs an interactive session'), and the interactive resume answers the release confirm without re-asking the plan gate (selections stay ["Plan approval"]).

Operator warning wording carries the mandated `K-π ` prefix: `K-π feedback is required to request plan changes`, `K-π feedback must be at most 4000 characters (got N)`, and `K-π job <id>: stack.json could not be summarised: <reason>` (the design's bare 'Feedback is required...' text is contained in the first).

The `Full plan:` line is built as a POSIX string `${CONFIG_DIR_NAME}/runs/<job>/stack.json` rather than path.join so the dialog line is identical on every platform; when a human node has no `detail` the summary block and the Full plan line are omitted (no blank lines).

An unknown select answer (not one of PLAN_GATE_OPTIONS) throws `<title> was answered with an option it did not offer: <choice>` rather than being treated as a request for changes - a named failure path for a misbehaving UI/RPC client.
The release gate's approval.result now also carries `question` (the design records `question: pending.question` for every answer, both gates).

Added `assertInvalid({ ...eventPayload("node.finished"), approved: true })` to the existing drift test, as plan.json's shared contract asks; the task's DECISIONS list did not mention it but did not forbid it.

loopSessions' `stack: ""` branch was folded into the generic `options.stack ?? healthStack` expression ("" ?? x is ""), behaviour unchanged; `stacks` (per-run sequence) and `prompts` (`<node>\n<prompt>` capture) were added as the design required.
